why: Both proposals use the same dark wood table and gray-taupe nailhead chairs, but A orders 12 chairs, which can't fit around a 198 cm table, and its light mid-century walnut sideboard looks less classic. B orders the right six chairs and adds a warm caned buffet that suits the classic-yet-current brief. The 51 cm drum pendant in both is a little small to be the large statement light over a 2 m table.
